meta.name: on-page-seo-auditor
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "audit on-page SEO" or "diagnose why a single page dropped"; scores titles, meta, header structure, keyword placement, links, and images with prioritized fixes. Not for E-E-A-T / publish-readiness scoring — use content-quality-auditor; not for crawl / CWV / indexing — use technical-seo-checker. 页面SEO审计/排名诊断

copy.tagline: 诊断单页SEO问题并给出修复优先级
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在排查某个网页排名下滑的原因
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose on-page SEO issues with prioritized fixes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are investigating why a single page dropped in search rankings

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会审计单页面的标题、描述、标题结构、关键词、链接和图片，给出每项评分和优先修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求“审计页面SEO”或“诊断页面排名下降”时触发。

say.text: 审计 example.com 的页面SEO，目标关键词是“最佳降噪耳机”。
say.note: Claude 会逐项评分并列出修复优先级。

say.text: 对比我的页面和竞争对手页面的SEO。
say.note: Claude 会对比两个URL的SEO要素。

howto.what_en: Audits a single page's title, meta description, header structure, keyword placement, links, and images, providing scored results and prioritized fix recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "audit on-page SEO" or "diagnose why a single page dropped".

say_en.text: Audit on-page SEO of example.com targeting 'best noise cancelling headphones'.
say_en.note: Claude will score each element and list fixes by priority.

say_en.text: Compare on-page SEO of my URL vs competitor URL for keyword.
say_en.note: Claude will compare SEO elements between two pages.
